title: Filament Spool Remaining and Runout Warning
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer firmware telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), filament spools (`filament:spool`), CNC/laser jobs (`cnc:job`), workshop air (`workshop:air`), cordless tool batteries (`tool:battery`).
app: OctoPrint / Klipper (Moonraker) print servers, printer firmware telemetry, filament spool tracking, CNC/laser job logs, and workshop air/tool sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=filament:spool
| stats latest(remaining_g) as grams by spool material color
| eval runs_low=if(grams<100,1,0)
| sort grams
description: Estimates the grams of filament left on each spool and warns before one runs out mid-print.
value: A spool running out during a long print wastes hours of work; a low-filament warning lets you swap or reorder in time.
implementation: Track remaining filament weight per spool; schedule daily and flag spools running low.
visualization: Table of spools sorted by grams remaining with a low warning.
grandmaExplanation: It estimates how much printing plastic is left on each reel and warns you before it runs out during a print.
